text:
Picture a tiler in Osborne Park. He opens Google Search Console.

People found his website by searching "shower regrout Osborne Park."

His website has no page about regrouting.

He writes one.

Search Console is free. See which searches bring people to you. Give the best ones their own page.

Flat out before Christmas? Good. That's a lot of happy customers.

Ask every one of them for a Google review.

Before you drive off, text your review link: "Thanks Mick, mind leaving a quick review? Helps heaps."

Ten seconds a job. Google's help page names reviews as part of your local ranking.

Christmas is a month away. Somewhere an agency is promising a brand-new business the top three on Google by then.

A new business takes months to climb Google's map.

Anyone promising Christmas is guessing.

Hire the person who tells you it takes months.
